    17	template<class Less, class Observer>
    18	void merge_range(Values& values, Values& buffer, std::size_t begin,
    19	                 std::size_t middle, std::size_t end, Less less, Observer observer) noexcept {
    20	    observer.merge(begin, middle, end);
    21	    auto left=begin, right=middle, out=begin;
    22	    while (left<middle && right<end) {
    23	        if (less(values[right], values[left])) buffer[out++]=values[right++];
    24	        else buffer[out++]=values[left++];
    25	    }
    26	    while (left<middle) buffer[out++]=values[left++];
    27	    while (right<end) buffer[out++]=values[right++];
    28	    std::copy(buffer.begin()+begin, buffer.begin()+end, values.begin()+begin);
    29	}
    30	template<class Less, class Observer>
    31	void serial_range(Values& values, Values& buffer, std::size_t begin,
    32	                  std::size_t end, Less less, Observer observer) noexcept {
    33	    const auto size=end-begin;
    34	    for (std::size_t width=1; width<size;) {
    35	        for (auto first=begin; first<end;) {
    36	            const auto middle=first+std::min(width,end-first);
    37	            const auto last=middle+std::min(width,end-middle);
    38	            merge_range(values,buffer,first,middle,last,less,observer);
    39	            first=last;
    40	        }
    41	        if (width>=size-width) break;
    42	        width*=2;
    43	    }
    44	}
